name: formality_topics_v1
description: The 20 contrast topics of the formality-contrast (CAA difference-of-means) vector class. ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: the topic index drives the per-(topic, template) generation seed, so this list must be consumed exactly as written (set_a then set_b, each in its own source order).

set_a: Teaching a child to ride a bike
set_b: How memory works in the brain

topics: Teaching a child to ride a bike
How memory works in the brain

provenance.source_selection: topics = concat(d['topics'][s] for s in d['vmb_stage0_strata']['topic_sets']) — the Stage-0 protocol loader's rule (vmb_stage0_generate.load_stage0_protocol). Iterating d['topics'] directly yields the 4 SET KEYS, not the topics, which is the 8-pairs-instead-of-40 rake this file exists to make impossible.
provenance.named_limit: TOPIC LEAKAGE: these topics ARE the frozen transport corpus's topic universe (set_a + set_b), so the transport maps were fit on text from the same topics the contrast is built from. Every readout that consumes a vector built from this file names that limit.
